data.one_liner: Lightweight library for encoding and decoding JSON5 with comments and trailing commas.
data.what_it_does: It encodes and decodes JSON5 data formats in Dart and Flutter. It supports parsing comments, unquoted keys, trailing commas, and special numeric values like NaN and Infinity.
use_when: You need to parse configuration files that include comments or trailing commas
You are working with JSON5 formatted APIs or data structures
avoid_when: You require high-performance serialization for deeply complex custom class hierarchies beyond List and Map
strengths: Supports comments and trailing commas which standard JSON lacks
Works across all major platforms including Flutter web and native
weaknesses: Only serializes classes which implement List and Map
Port of a JavaScript library which might differ slightly from idiomatic Dart conventions
